arguments.content:
units metal
dimension 3
boundary p p p
atom_style atomic

# Create FCC lattice
lattice fcc 4.05
region box block 0 10 0 10 0 10
create_box 1 box
create_atoms 1 box
mass 1 26.98

# Define potential
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/EAM/Al_zhou.eam.alloy Al

# Energy minimization
minimize 1.0e-6 1.0e-8 1000 10000

# Define temperature and timestep
timestep 0.001
velocity all create 300.0 12345

# Equilibration in NPT
fix 1 all npt temp 300.0 300.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
thermo 1000
run 20000

unfix 1

# Reset time step counter
reset_timestep 0

# Tensile deformation
fix 1 all npt temp 300.0 300.0 0.1 y 0.0 0.0 1.0 z 0.0 0.0 1.0
fix 2 all deform 1 x erate 0.01 units box remap x

# Output settings
variable strain equal "(lx - v_L0)/v_L0"
variable L0 equal ${lx}
variable stress_xx equal "pxx/10000"  # Convert to GPa
variable stress_yy equal "pyy/10000"
variable stress_zz equal "pzz/10000"

dump 1 all custom 100 dump.tensile id type x y z
thermo 100
thermo_style custom step v_strain v_stress_xx v_stress_yy v_stress_zz pe ke temp

# Output stress-strain data
fix ss_output all print 100 "${strain} ${stress_xx} ${stress_yy} ${stress_zz}" file stress_strain.txt screen no title "strain stress_xx stress_yy stress_zz"

run 20000

boundary p p p
atom_style atomic

# Create FCC lattice
lattice fcc 4.05
region box block 0 10 0 10 0 10
create_box 1 box
create_atoms 1 box
mass 1 26.98

# Define potential
pair_style eam
pair_coeff * * /potentials/EAM/Al.eam

# Energy minimization
minimize 1.0e-6 1.0e-8 1000 10000

# Store initial length
variable L0 equal lx
variable strain equal "(lx - v_L0)/v_L0"
variable stress_xx equal "pxx/10000"  # Convert to GPa
variable stress_yy equal "pyy/10000"
variable stress_zz equal "pzz/10000"

# Define temperature and timestep
timestep 0.001
velocity all create 300.0 12345

# Equilibration in NPT
fix 1 all npt temp 300.0 300.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
thermo 1000
run 20000

unfix 1

# Reset time step counter
reset_timestep 0

# Tensile deformation
fix 1 all npt temp 300.0 300.0 0.1 y 0.0 0.0 1.0 z 0.0 0.0 1.0
fix 2 all deform 1 x erate 0.01 units box remap x

# Output settings
dump 1 all custom 100 dump.lammpstrj id type x y z
thermo 100
thermo_style custom step v_strain v_stress_xx v_stress_yy v_stress_zz pe ke temp

# Output stress-strain data
fix ss_output all print 100 "${strain} ${stress_xx} ${stress_yy} ${stress_zz}" file stress_strain.txt screen no title "strain stress_xx stress_yy stress_zz"

run 20000

# LAMMPS input script for Al FCC simulation

# Initialize system
units metal
dimension 3
boundary p p p
atom_style atomic

# Create lattice and simulation box

create_box 1 box
create_atoms 1 box

minimize 1e-10 1e-10 100000 100000

# Set timestep
timestep 0.001

# Output settings
thermo 100
thermo_style custom step temp press pe ke etotal density

# Run NPT for equilibration
run 1000

# Print final density
print "Final density = ${density}"

arguments.content:
# LAMMPS input script for Aluminum STGB
units metal
dimension 3
boundary p p p
atom_style atomic

# Create regions and lattice
lattice fcc 4.05
region box block 0 30 0 30 0 30
create_box 1 box
create_atoms 1 region box

# Define upper region orientation
region upper block 0 30 15 30 0 30
group upper region upper
displace_atoms upper rotate 0 0 0 1 0 0 0.6435 0 0 0

# Define lower region orientation
region lower block 0 30 0 15 0 30
group lower region lower
displace_atoms lower rotate 0 0 0 1 0 0 -0.6435 0 0 0

# Set up potential
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/EAM/Al_zhou.eam.alloy Al

# Delete overlapping atoms
delete_atoms overlap 0.35 upper lower

# Energy minimization 1
minimize 1e-15 1e-15 5000 5000
compute csym all centro/atom fcc
compute pe all pe/atom
dump min1 all custom 1000 dump.minimization1.* id type x y z c_csym c_pe
run 0
undump min1

# Box relaxation and minimization 2
fix 1 all box/relax z 0.0
minimize 1e-15 1e-15 5000 5000
unfix 1

# Save final configuration
write_data final_gb.data

# Compute energies for GB energy calculation
variable E equal "pe"
run 0
variable total_energy equal $E
variable num_atoms equal "count(all)"
variable gb_area equal "lx*lz"
variable bulk_energy equal "-3.360000*v_num_atoms"
variable gb_energy equal "(v_total_energy-v_bulk_energy)/(2*v_gb_area)"
variable gb_energy_mjm2 equal "v_gb_energy*16021.7733"  # Convert from eV/Å² to mJ/m²

print "GB Energy (mJ/m²) = ${gb_energy_mjm2}"

# LAMMPS input script for thermal conductivity calculation

# Initialize simulation
units           lj
atom_style      atomic
dimension       3
boundary        p p p

# Create simulation box and atoms
lattice         fcc 0.6
region          box block 0 10 0 10 0 20
create_box      1 box
create_atoms    1 box
mass            1 1.0

# Define interatomic potential
pair_style      lj/cut 2.5
pair_coeff      1 1 1.0 1.0

# Define regions for temperature control
region          hot block INF INF INF INF 0 1
region          cold block INF INF INF INF 10 11
group           hot dynamic all region hot
group           cold dynamic all region cold
group           middle subtract all hot cold

# Energy minimization
minimize        1.0e-4 1.0e-6 1000 10000

# Initialize velocities
velocity        all create 1.35 12345 dist gaussian

# Equilibration in NVT
fix             1 all nvt temp 1.35 1.35 0.5
thermo          100
run             1000
unfix           1

# Production run with temperature gradient
compute         ke_hot hot ke/atom
compute         ke_cold cold ke/atom
compute         temp_hot hot temp
compute         temp_cold cold temp
compute         temp_middle middle temp
compute         chunk all chunk/atom bin/1d z 0.0 20.0 40 units reduced
fix             temp_profile all ave/chunk 100 100 10000 chunk temp/atom file temp_profile.dat

# Apply Langevin thermostats to hot and cold regions
fix             hot_thermostat hot langevin 1.70 1.70 1.0 699483
fix             cold_thermostat cold langevin 1.0 1.0 1.0 834729
fix             2 middle nve

# Run to establish steady state
thermo_style    custom step temp c_temp_hot c_temp_cold f_hot_thermostat f_cold_thermostat
thermo          1000
run             10000

# Reset Langevin energy accumulation
fix             hot_thermostat hot langevin 1.70 1.70 1.0 699483
fix             cold_thermostat cold langevin 1.0 1.0 1.0 834729

# Production run for thermal conductivity calculation
run             20000

print          "Thermal conductivity calculation completed"

# LAMMPS input script for thermal conductivity calculation

# Initialize simulation
units           lj
atom_style      atomic
dimension       3
boundary        p p p

# Create simulation box and atoms
lattice         fcc 0.6
region          box block 0 10 0 10 0 20
create_box      1 box
create_atoms    1 box
mass            1 1.0

# Define interatomic potential
pair_style      lj/cut 2.5
pair_coeff      1 1 1.0 1.0

# Define regions for temperature control
region          hot block 0 10 0 10 0 1
region          cold block 0 10 0 10 10 11
group           hot region hot
group           cold region cold
group           middle subtract all hot cold

# Energy minimization
minimize        1.0e-4 1.0e-6 1000 10000

# Initialize velocities
velocity        all create 1.35 12345 dist gaussian

# Equilibration in NVT
fix             1 all nvt temp 1.35 1.35 0.5
thermo          100
run             1000
unfix           1

# Production run with temperature gradient
variable        dz equal 20.0/40
variable        nchunk equal 40
compute         layers all chunk/atom bin/1d z 0.0 ${dz} ${nchunk}
fix             3 all ave/chunk 10 100 1000 layers temp file temp_profile.dat

# Apply Langevin thermostats
fix             hot_thermostat hot langevin 1.70 1.70 1.0 699483
fix             cold_thermostat cold langevin 1.0 1.0 1.0 834729
fix             2 middle nve

# Run to establish steady state
thermo_style    custom step temp f_hot_thermostat f_cold_thermostat
thermo          1000
run             10000

# Reset energy accumulators and continue for statistics
fix             hot_thermostat hot langevin 1.70 1.70 1.0 699483
fix             cold_thermostat cold langevin 1.0 1.0 1.0 834729

# Production run
run             20000

# Calculate thermal conductivity
variable        Q equal (-f_hot_thermostat+f_cold_thermostat)/2
variable        dT equal 0.7
variable        A equal 100
variable        L equal 9
variable        kappa equal abs(${Q}*${L}/(${A}*${dT}))
print          "Thermal conductivity = ${kappa}"

units           lj
atom_style      atomic
dimension       3

pair_coeff      1 1 1.0 1.0

# Read bulk energy per atom
with open('bulk_energy.txt', 'r') as f:
    bulk_text = f.read()
    bulk_energy_per_atom = float(re.findall(r'Bulk_Energy_per_atom = ([-\d.]+)', bulk_text)[0])

# Read surface energy per atom
with open('surface_energy.txt', 'r') as f:
    surf_text = f.read()
    surf_energy_per_atom = float(re.findall(r'Surface_Energy_per_atom = ([-\d.]+)', surf_text)[0])

# Calculate surface area (in Å²)
lattice_constant = 4.05  # Å
surface_area = 5 * lattice_constant * 5 * lattice_constant  # 5x5 unit cells

# Number of atoms in the surface layer (FCC (001) has 2 atoms per unit cell face)
surface_atoms = 2 * 5 * 5

# Calculate surface energy (in eV/Å²)
energy_diff = surf_energy_per_atom - bulk_energy_per_atom
surface_energy = (energy_diff * surface_atoms) / (2 * surface_area)  # Factor of 2 for two surfaces

# Write result
with open('final_surface_energy.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(str(surface_energy))

import re

def read_energy(filename):

        line = f.readline()
        return float(line.split('=')[1].strip())

def read_surface_data():

        lines = f.readlines()
        energy = float(lines[0].split('=')[1].strip())
        area = float(lines[1].split('=')[1].strip())
        return energy, area

# Read energies
bulk_energy_per_atom = read_energy('bulk_energy.txt')
surface_energy_per_atom, surface_area = read_surface_data()

# Calculate number of atoms (from bulk simulation)
n_atoms = 500  # 5x5x5 FCC unit cells = 4 atoms/cell * 125 cells

# Calculate surface energy
# Surface energy = (E_surface - E_bulk) / (2 * Area)
# Factor of 2 because we have two surfaces (top and bottom)
surface_energy = (surface_energy_per_atom * n_atoms - bulk_energy_per_atom * n_atoms) / (2 * surface_area)

# Convert from eV/Å² to J/m²
surface_energy_ev_per_a2 = surface_energy

# Write result
with open('final_surface_energy.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(str(surface_energy_ev_per_a2))

# LAMMPS input script for elastic constant calculation

# Initialize simulation
units metal
dimension 3
boundary p p p
atom_style atomic

# Create FCC aluminum lattice
lattice fcc 4.05
region box block 0 5 0 5 0 5
create_box 1 box
create_atoms 1 box

# Define potential
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/EAM/Al99.eam.alloy Al

# Energy minimization settings
minimize 1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000

# Initial relaxation
fix 1 all box/relax iso 0.0
minimize 1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000
unfix 1

# Store the relaxed state
write_data relaxed.data

# Calculate elastic constants
fix 1 all box/relax iso 0.0
minimize 1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000

# Define variables for strain increments
variable delta equal 1.0e-6
variable s11 equal "(v_delta,0,0,0,0,0)"
variable s22 equal "(0,v_delta,0,0,0,0)"
variable s33 equal "(0,0,v_delta,0,0,0)"
variable s12 equal "(0,0,0,v_delta,0,0)"
variable s13 equal "(0,0,0,0,v_delta,0)"
variable s23 equal "(0,0,0,0,0,v_delta)"

# Apply strains and calculate stresses
fix def all deform 1 trate ${s11} remap x
run 1
unfix def
minimize 1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000

fix def all deform 1 trate ${s22} remap x
run 1
unfix def
minimize 1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000

fix def all deform 1 trate ${s33} remap x
run 1
unfix def
minimize 1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000

fix def all deform 1 trate ${s12} remap x
run 1
unfix def
minimize 1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000

fix def all deform 1 trate ${s13} remap x
run 1
unfix def
minimize 1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000

fix def all deform 1 trate ${s23} remap x
run 1
unfix def
minimize 1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000

# Output stress components
thermo_style custom step pe press pxx pyy pzz pxy pxz pyz
thermo 1
run 0

# LAMMPS input script for elastic constant calculation

# Initialize simulation
units metal
dimension 3
boundary p p p
atom_style atomic

# Create FCC aluminum lattice
lattice fcc 4.05
region box block 0 5 0 5 0 5
create_box 1 box
create_atoms 1 box

# Define potential
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/EAM/Al99.eam.alloy Al

# Set up output
thermo 100
thermo_style custom step pe press pxx pyy pzz pxy pxz pyz lx ly lz

# Initial minimization
minimize 1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000

# Store initial box dimensions
variable L0 equal lx
variable V0 equal vol

# Initial relaxation
fix 1 all box/relax iso 0.0
minimize 1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000
unfix 1

# Apply small strains and measure stress
variable delta equal 0.001
variable s equal 1.0+${delta}
variable sm equal 1.0-${delta}

# C11
change_box all x scale ${s} remap
minimize 1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000
variable C11 equal -(pxx)/${delta}/10000  # Convert to GPa

# Reset box
change_box all x scale ${sm} remap
minimize 1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000

# C22
change_box all y scale ${s} remap
minimize 1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000
variable C22 equal -(pyy)/${delta}/10000

# Reset box
change_box all y scale ${sm} remap
minimize 1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000

# C33
change_box all z scale ${s} remap
minimize 1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000
variable C33 equal -(pzz)/${delta}/10000

# Calculate Bulk Modulus (Voigt average)
variable B equal (${C11}+${C22}+${C33})/9

# Output results
print "C11 = ${C11} GPa"
print "C22 = ${C22} GPa"
print "C33 = ${C33} GPa"
print "Bulk Modulus = ${B} GPa"

# LAMMPS input script for calculating bulk modulus of Aluminum

# Initialize simulation
units           metal
dimension       3
boundary        p p p
atom_style      atomic

# Create FCC lattice
lattice         fcc 4.05
region          box block 0 5 0 5 0 5
create_box      1 box
create_atoms    1 box

# Define potential
pair_style      eam/alloy
pair_coeff      * * /potentials/EAM/Al99.eam.alloy Al

# Energy minimization settings
minimize        1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000

# Initial relaxation
fix             1 all box/relax iso 0.0
minimize        1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000
unfix           1

# Store the relaxed configuration
write_dump      all custom relaxed.dump id type x y z

# Calculate elastic constants through deformation
variable        up equal 0.003
variable        down equal -${up}

# +e1
change_box      all x scale 1.003 remap
minimize        1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000
run            0
variable        p11 equal -pxx/10000 # Convert to GPa
variable        p22 equal -pyy/10000
variable        p33 equal -pzz/10000

# Reset box
read_dump       relaxed.dump 0 x y z box yes replace yes

# -e1
change_box      all x scale 0.997 remap
minimize        1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000
run            0
variable        m11 equal -pxx/10000
variable        m22 equal -pyy/10000
variable        m33 equal -pzz/10000

# Reset box
read_dump       relaxed.dump 0 x y z box yes replace yes

# +e2
change_box      all y scale 1.003 remap
minimize        1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000
run            0
variable        p12 equal -pxx/10000
variable        p13 equal -pyy/10000
variable        p23 equal -pzz/10000

# Calculate elastic constants
variable        C11 equal (${p11}-${m11})/(2.0*${up})
variable        C12 equal (${p12}-${m22})/(2.0*${up})
variable        C13 equal (${p13}-${m33})/(2.0*${up})

# Calculate bulk modulus (Voigt average)
variable        bulk_modulus equal (${C11}+2.0*${C12})/3.0

# Output results
print          "Bulk Modulus (GPa) = ${bulk_modulus}"

variable        P0 equal press

print          "Initial_Pressure ${P0}"

variable        P1 equal press

print          "Final_Pressure ${P1}"

variable        dP equal (${P1}-${P0})/10000  # Convert to GPa
variable        B equal -${dP}/${dV}
print          "Bulk_Modulus ${B}"

# LAMMPS input script for bulk modulus calculation

units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p

# Create FCC aluminum lattice
lattice fcc 4.05
region box block 0 5 0 5 0 5
create_box 1 box
create_atoms 1 box

# Define potential
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/EAM/Al99.eam.alloy Al

# Energy minimization
minimize 1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000

# Output initial volume and energy
variable V0 equal vol
variable E0 equal pe
print "Initial volume = ${V0}"
print "Initial energy = ${E0}"

# Apply volumetric strain
variable delta equal 0.001
variable factor equal (1.0-${delta})
change_box all x scale ${factor} y scale ${factor} z scale ${factor} remap

# Minimize again
minimize 1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000

# Calculate new energy and volume
variable V1 equal vol
variable E1 equal pe
variable dV equal ${V0}-${V1}
variable dE equal ${E1}-${E0}

# Calculate bulk modulus (in GPa)
# B = -V(dP/dV) ≈ V0 * (d²E/dV²)
variable B equal ${V0}*${E1}/(${dV}*${dV})*160.21766208 # Convert from eV/Å³ to GPa

print "Bulk modulus = ${B} GPa"

next i
jump SELF strainloop

import numpy as np

# Read the strain-energy data
data = np.loadtxt('strain_energy.txt')
strains = data[:, 0]
volumes = data[:, 1]
energies = data[:, 2]

# Calculate the initial volume
V0 = volumes[len(volumes)//2]  # The middle point corresponds to zero strain

# Fit the energy vs volume data to a quadratic function
coeffs = np.polyfit(volumes/V0 - 1, energies, 2)

# The bulk modulus is related to the second derivative of energy with respect to volume
# B = V0 * (d^2E/dV^2) at V = V0
bulk_modulus = 2 * coeffs[0] / V0  # in eV/Å³

# Convert to GPa (1 eV/Å³ = 160.21766208 GPa)
bulk_modulus_GPa = bulk_modulus * 160.21766208

# Save the result
with open('bulk_modulus_result.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(str(bulk_modulus_GPa))

import numpy as np

# Read the stress-strain data
data = np.loadtxt('stress_strain.txt')
strains = data[:, 0]
stresses = data[:, 1]  # in bars (LAMMPS metal units)

# Calculate the slope of stress vs strain (this is the bulk modulus in bars)
bulk_modulus_bars = np.polyfit(strains, stresses, 1)[0]

# Convert from bars to GPa (1 bar = 1e-4 GPa)
bulk_modulus_GPa = bulk_modulus_bars * 1e-4

# Save the result
with open('bulk_modulus_result.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(str(bulk_modulus_GPa))

# LAMMPS input script for bulk modulus calculation

create_atoms 1 box

# Energy minimization
minimize 1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000

# Calculate elastic constants
fix 1 all box/relax iso 0.0
minimize 1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000
unfix 1

# Calculate bulk modulus using elastic constants

variable c22 equal c_press[5]
variable c33 equal c_press[9]
variable c12 equal c_press[2]
variable c13 equal c_press[3]
variable c23 equal c_press[6]

# Bulk modulus in Voigt notation (in bars)
variable B equal (c11+c22+c33+2*(c12+c13+c23))/9.0

# Convert to GPa (1 bar = 1e-4 GPa)
variable B_GPa equal v_B*1.0e-4

print "Bulk modulus: ${B_GPa} GPa"
